patterns.regex: A/C [xX*]*(?<account>\d{3,6}) debited by (?:Rs\.?\s*)?(?<amount>[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?) on date (?<date>\d{2}[A-Za-z]{3}\d{2}) trf to (?<merchant>.+?) Refno (?<ref>\d+)
A/c [xX*]*(?<account>\d{3,6})-credited by (?:Rs\.?\s*)?(?<amount>[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?) on (?<date>\d{2}[A-Za-z]{3}\d{2}) transfer from (?<merchant>.+?) Ref No (?<ref>\d+)

A/C [xX*]*(?<account>\d{3,6}) has a debit by (?:transfer|ATM withdrawal|cash withdrawal) of (?:Rs\.?|INR)\s*(?<amount>[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?) on (?<date>\d{2}/\d{2}/\d{2})\. Avl Bal (?:Rs\.?|INR)\s*(?<balance>[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?)
